control._mode_note: 2026-08-19: switched legacy -> strict ahead of the first autonomous supervisor run, approved by the project owner. Rationale: PLAN.md was the last shared-write surface, and its lost-update race had already fired 4x under human supervision; unattended it corrupts the blackboard with nobody watching. Strict makes the supervisor the sole writer -- dispatch.* claims before launch, builders emit a devteam-control fence instead of editing PLAN.md, and the firewall protects PLAN.md outright. Verified before flipping: all 12 strict-mode firewall tests green, dispatch.ps1 implements claim-at-dispatch + fence prompt + capture, and control.py claim now resolves units from the builder registry (it previously crashed on S5, which under strict would have silently skipped every S5 dispatch). Rollback is a one-line revert to legacy; see docs/CONTROL.md.
